scope: 19 discovery entries; five detailed PSI metadata briefs; five FLEX measurements checked against the NASA table. No partial-gravity data or safety certification is provided.

investigations.name: FLEX
investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
investigations.summary: Studies liquid-fuel droplet burning and extinction under different atmospheres in microgravity.
investigations.objectives: Studies liquid-fuel droplet burning and extinction under different atmospheres in microgravity.
investigations.approach: Droplet ignition tests vary atmosphere and droplet size to examine burning and extinction. The imported table sample covers five methanol tests only.
investigations.relevance: Supports investigation of atmospheric composition, droplet combustion, and gaseous suppression.
investigations.conditions: The five example rows here use methanol and an initial oxygen mole fraction of 0.21. They are only a small subset.
investigations.measurements: Example fields include ambient pressure, droplet diameter, burn duration, and test-end classification.
investigations.limitations: Droplet tests do not establish safe conditions for solid spacecraft materials. These five rows cannot isolate a causal effect.
investigations.source_section: Version 5: Objectives, Approach, Experimental Table rows 1–5
investigations.earthApplications: Potential applications require separate validation; no technology-transfer claim is made.
investigations.ranking_basis: Team editorial navigation score: 8 for prevention, detection or suppression; 6 for fundamental combustion. Not a measured safety rating.

investigations.approach: See the linked NASA PSI Objectives and Approach sections.
